content: Table TABREF35 shows the model architecture comparison between all the models experimented. The features used for Stanford CRF classifier are words, letter n-grams of upto length 6, previous word and next word. This model is trained till the current function value is less than $1\mathrm {e}{-2}$. The hyper-parameters of neural network experiments are set as shown in table TABREF30. Since, word embedding of character-level and grapheme-level is random, their scores are near.
